actual: Constraint documented and behavior observed: in valid JSON the segment key can appear only once, and when a raw body forces the duplicate the server keeps the LAST value (seat 14D) and drops the first (14C) without any error or warning. plain.s: Accepted: booking OURGLZ has only seat 14D; seat 14C was silently dropped
plain.x: Unknown — document the behaviour rather than expect a specific refusal
plain.a: Documented: a normal request cannot even express two seats on one flight, and a repeated entry silently keeps the last one

text: Full-suite run: all 63 rows of SeatMap_TestCases.csv (V2, GulfAir / KSA, staging ndc-integration-stg-ne-3), requested as Round 18. Every row was executed or explicitly classified, using a standalone Node harness with the V2 Postman collection bodies: 192 API calls in total across 25 real bookings/holds. Several chains ran in parallel; the disk log was written in one batch after all calls finished (not per test case in real time), so each test case's reporting_started_at/reporting_ended_at brackets a real JSONL append + Markdown re-render taken at write-up time, not at verdict time. HEADLINE: no new defect; all twelve tracked defects reproduced unchanged (BUG-01, 02, 03, 04, 05, 06, 07, 08, 09, 15, 17 and BUG-18 for the 2nd time). BUG-16 (Book error while silently creating the booking) and BUG-19 (valid seat silently dropped) did NOT reproduce. Environment notes: GulfAir returned no offers for BAH departures from 2027-07-09, so the first attempt of 8 chains dated 2027-07-09..15 (empty Search results, no booking made) was repeated on early/mid June 2027 dates and only the repeated chains are counted; a booked seat turns into a NoSeat cell on the next seat map; every cellCharacteristics padisCode is still "Unknown". BND-02/BND-03/BND-04/BIZ-02/VAL-05..VAL-11 were evaluated over all 18 seat maps captured this round (20 segments); SEC-02 is a documentation case (no API call); INT-02/INT-03 are out of scope for a single-supplier run; the bundle/ancillary, SeatAfterHold-dependent and supplier-failure cases are BLOCKED for the reasons stated in each card.
